description: This Java class 'ConnectivityMongoEventAdapter' extends 'AbstractMongoEventAdapter' to serialize and deserialize 'ConnectivityEvent's for MongoDB persistence, specifically handling connection-related events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It sets up an event registry with strategies to parse 'ConnectionCreated' and 'ConnectionModified' events from JSON, utilizing migration utilities.

classes.name: ConnectivityMongoEventAdapter
classes.description: A final class that adapts connectivity events for MongoDB persistence, providing event registry configuration for parsing 'ConnectionCreated' and 'ConnectionModified' events from JSON.

methods.name: ConnectivityMongoEventAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with an ActorSystem and sets up the event registry.

methods.name: createEventRegistry
methods.description: Creates and returns an 'EventRegistry' with strategies to parse connectivity-related events from JSON.
